title: Kantian Deontology Meets AI Alignment: Towards Morally Grounded Fairness Metrics
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion or faith. Its focus is on applying secular moral philosophy, specifically Kantian deontology, to the field of AI fairness metrics, contrasting it with the prevalent utilitarian approaches.
